## Profile

I am an Assistant Professor in Machine Learning and Computer Vision at Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. My research focuses on machine learning and signal processing for graphs and higher-order structures, with applications across computer vision, environmental monitoring, materials, underwater acoustics, and circuit design.

## Education

- **PhD in Applied Mathematics**, La Rochelle Université, 2019–2022. Visiting researcher at CentraleSupélec/Inria/Université Paris-Saclay and Università di Napoli Parthenope.
- **MSc in Engineering, with honors**, Universidad de Antioquia, 2016–2018. Visiting research scholar at the University of Delaware.
- **BSc in Electronics Engineering**, Universidad de Antioquia, 2011–2016.

## Selected responsibilities

- Elected substitute member, Télécom Paris Research Committee, 2025–present.
- Course lead, **Machine Learning with Graphs**, 2024–present.
- Member, IDS Department Council, Télécom Paris, 2023–present.

## Awards and honors

- Top 200 Reviewer, ICLR 2026; Gold Reviewer, ICML 2026.
- Best Paper Award, ICCV 2023 Artificial Social Intelligence Workshop.

## Professional service

Service includes area-chair, program-committee, reviewing, workshop-organization, and session-chair roles across NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, AISTATS, ECCV, ECML, WACV, ICASSP, JMLR, and multiple IEEE Transactions.
